content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00078 If a data element has been received invalidated in case of Inter-ECU communication where receiving software components requesting different values for handleInvalid and the attribute handleInvalid is set to replace for an particular r-port – RTE shall perform the "invalid value substitution" with the initValue for the r-port . Then the reception will be handled as if a valid value would have been received (activation of runnable entities using the DataReceivedEvent ).
